info.title: Netriun Nexus API
info.description: Multi-tenant workspace API. Lists return {data: [...]}; errors return {error: message}. Login tokens expire after 12 hours. Community workspaces include one owner and five additional users. Account creation requires credentials; PUT account requests may omit credentials to preserve them.
